video_title: Will Austin Reaves $ Doom the Lakers & What About LeBron? (with Law Murray)

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' value and the difficulty of NBA free agency
quotes.excerpt: Austin Reaves was going to get paid and he's got really good representation.
quotes.quote: Free agency is really difficult and these teams talk so much. That's why we have the trash rumor mill that we have now. Austin Reaves was going to get paid and he's got really good representation. These dudes have a feel and the pulse of the league and he offers an ability that, if he would have left, he would have been a difference-maker wherever he would go. I've got a lot of respect for Austin Reaves' game and so do a lot of teams in the league.

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' aggressive roster building and the Austin Reaves signing
quotes.excerpt: The way the Lakers operate, they always trying to get over.
quotes.quote: The way the Lakers operate, they always trying to get over. What players can we get because we're the Lakers, and I'm sure they tried that with Austin Reaves. It worked once. The dude went undrafted, instead of ironically, he could have been drafted by a team in the round two five years ago. He would have been the best damn player in that draft and that outside the lottery easily. I really feel like Austin Reaves, forget how much you're paying him, there are some things that aren't replaceable.

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' chemistry with Luka Doncic is irreplaceable
quotes.excerpt: The fact that he has a rhythm with Luka Doncic is significant. You can't mess that up.
quotes.quote: The fact that he has a rhythm with Luka Doncic is significant. You can't mess that up. There are things that I don't feel like the Lakers are going to hit every box when it comes to what Luka Doncic feels like he needs to have a better chance at things next year. You can act like the Lakers were contenders last year if you want to. I never did and I got a lot of people locking me as so. But I think everyone is being real about their situation. I think Austin Reaves is pretty cool to retain.

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler and Jaylen Duren's restricted free agency outlook
quotes.excerpt: When we're talking about restricted free agency, that's a little thing called a nightmare.
quotes.quote: When we're talking about restricted free agency, that's a little thing called a nightmare. And restricted free agency is a nightmare, you know. I'm not the cover of the restricted free agency in the Clippers. It's not going to be, yeah, you might want to pitch a tent. I think Jaylen Duren is more likely to stay. He's an All-Star. He was an All-NBA selection. He was a player who contributed to the number one seed in the Eastern Conference, a 60-win team. A team that was terrible, the worst team in basketball just two years ago.

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler's potential return and Jazz roster complications
quotes.excerpt: Walker Kessler is a player who I feel like he's going to be back as well.
quotes.quote: Walker Kessler is a player who I feel like he's going to be back as well. But I can see how this thing gets complicated. The Jazz have been tanking. Walker Kessler missed every game after November this past season. Walker Kessler is an effective player when he's played and I swear so many of these dudes, basketball is not playing. If he plays five games and everybody's lining up to get him on their team and what not. But the thing with the Jazz is if you pay him, and this is the concern with them, it's like, you got a lot of money on the books. That Jazz team is going to be intriguing, but they already have a lot of money tied up in their frontcourt.

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: John Collins' contract extension and Utah's roster decisions
quotes.excerpt: John Collins played really well last year. He justified having an extension himself.
quotes.quote: John Collins played really well last year. He justified having an extension himself. We're not even talking about John Collins because that decision is not going to be made until October. But it's going to be very interesting to see what happens in Utah, a team that got to win and I can I can believe the angels this year when they say they are going to take. So with Walker Kessler, he's a good player, but what's it going to take? And plus we also saw, ironically, this is how Walker Kessler got to the Utah in the first place, we also saw restricted free agency in the case of John Collins resulting in a massive trade as well.

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' history with Joel Embiid and the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Joel wanted him on the Sixers, okay, back in 2018. Like, really, really bad.
quotes.quote: Back in Joel Embiid was the best troll in basketball. Joel wanted him on the Sixers, okay, back in 2018. Like, really, really bad. And when LeBron left Cleveland for the Lakers, Joel had one of my favorite of his troll tweets when he was like, I'm paraphrasing, but he was like, they're not going to like you in Los Angeles. That's Kobe's town. And that dude LeBron, it's been that's how it's felt. Like he's been polarizing in a Los Angeles uniform because you got Bron fans, you got Lakers fans, you got Kobe fans. It's a whole mess. I hate it.

quotes.speaker: Law Murray
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' understanding of the NBA landscape and market
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is a proud dude and he's a calculated dude as far as understanding the landscape.
quotes.quote: LeBron can play and I'm sure LeBron wants to come back and play, but LeBron is a proud dude and he's a calculated dude as far as understanding the landscape in the league and every little thing. He knows he's being watched. That dude will be the first to tell you about the man in the arena. And that's a long way of saying, I feel like the team LeBron plays for is going to be a team that appropriately fits the story. I don't know how he gets to any other places that that would qualify for.
